incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — spike in 5xx + gateway timeouts observed across us-west-2. auto-paging oncall. tagging #incidents :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: Ack. Investigating initial blast radius. Seeing increase in gateway 502/504 from front proxy into inference cluster.

karen-sre: I'm looking at scheduler metrics — backlog in batching queue up ~4x, avg queue time jumped to 2.1s, p95 token latency up.

leo-eng: Logs from the runtime show repeated "KV cache miss" churn and long GC pauses on a subset of model nodes. Possible head-of-line blocking when a few workers stall and the scheduler waits for batches.

chris-ml: Which model variant is hot? I see heavy traffic to redwood/open-chat-3b@v12 on a few pools. Any batched requests with long prefix lengths?

karen-sre: yes, majority from that variant and many requests have long context > 4k tokens. Batching scheduler tries to pack them and stalls other short requests behind them (HOL).

eng-runtime: Dumped batching queue state and aligned with recent deploys — a config change earlier today increased max_batch_bytes for that pool. That allowed huge batches and exposed a pathological sequence distribution.

leo-eng: Can we throttle that pool temporarily and route 10% to an older v10 fallback?

sre-oncall: Doing quick mitigation plan: 1) Enable traffic split: route 20% of requests for model->v10 2) reduce max_batch_bytes back to previous 3) scale pool by +2 nodes 4) increase scheduler per-request timeout from 30s to 45s to avoid immediate 5xx storms while we stabilize.

maria-cs: Heads up — customers ACorp and BetaApps reported elevated errors via support. We should prep a short customer message. Severity?

david-support: Support sees 15% error rate for requests hitting that variant, roughly 30% of their requests time out. They're asking if there's a workaround.

chris-ml: Rolling split now: `runtimectl route set redwood/open-chat-3b@v12 --split 80,20 --variants v12,v10`

eng-runtime: split applied. Monitoring.

incident-bot: action:traffic-split applied by chris-ml — 80/20 v12/v10

karen-sre: Lowered max_batch_bytes to previous value with hotpatch: `sed -i 's/max_batch_bytes: 2000000/max_batch_bytes: 500000/' /etc/runtime/pools/open-chat-3b.yaml && service runtime reload`

leo-eng: Hotpatch applied and pool config reloaded. Starting node scale now: `cloudctl scale pool oc3b --add 2`

sre-oncall: Scale started. Also kicking off rolling restart of the three tail workers that showed GC spikes.

eng-runtime: Rolling restart in progress.

karen-sre: Observed queue length dropping slowly. 5xx rate reduced from 18% to ~6% after split and restart. p95 latency still elevated but trending down.

maria-cs: Drafting customer note: "We're investigating elevated errors affecting some requests to open-chat-3b. We've applied a temporary routing change and configuration rollback. We'll update in 30m with status."

david-support: sending note to ACorp + BetaApps now.

chris-ml: Observed that a small fraction of requests have extremely long prompt tokens (user-constructed loops) causing oversized batches. We should add a quick mitigation to cap prefix length at gateway for that model.

leo-eng: Agreed. Pushing gate cap: `gatewayctl set limit --model oc3b --prefix-tokens 4096`

eng-runtime: Gateway cap set. New incoming requests beyond cap get 413 with friendly text pointing to docs (temporary measure).

karen-sre: After cap and restarts, 5xx down to ~1.2%, queue stable. Will continue to monitor for 30m.

sre-oncall: Preparing incident severity: currently P2 (impacted but mitigations in place), customers notified. If we see another spike >5% sustained for 10m, we'll elevate to P1.

incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled in 50 minutes to @karen-sre -> @leo-eng (next rotation).

sre-oncall: Handoff summary for next oncall (copy/paste): "Root cause: config change allowed oversized batching which, combined with a small set of long-context requests, caused head-of-line blocking in batching scheduler and GC/backpressure on a subset of workers. Mitigations done: traffic split to fallback v10, rollback max_batch_bytes, scale +2 nodes, rolling restarts of bad workers, gateway prefix cap, customer notifications. Current status: stable, 5xx ~1.2%, p95 latency improving. Monitoring 30m. Escalation criteria: sustained 5%+ 5xx or queue length > 60 for 5m. Contacts: chris-ml, leo-eng, karen-sre, david-support."

leo-eng: I'll take follow-up if anything pops after handoff.

karen-sre: Handing off in 10m. Quick note: saved relevant logs to /var/log/incidents/1718709123/ and uploaded core dump artifacts to S3 bucket s3://redwood-debug/1718709123/.

maria-cs: I'll keep customers updated and share incident postmortem template.

sre-oncall: Leaving a small runbook note: consider implementing per-request batching priority (short tasks over long) and an alert on avg_batch_size_spread to catch this pattern earlier.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE recorded.

karen-sre: Handoff: I'm stepping out. All current mitigations in place. Please escalate to chris/leo if errors climb.

leo-eng: Acknowledged — taking watch.

maria-cs: Thanks everyone. Will follow up with customers once we have stable metrics for 30m.

david-support: Closing support thread for now; will reopen if customers report further errors.

incident-bot: Thread closed by karen-sre (handed off) — monitoring continues."
